zh: 别的电脑发来的活，等你拍板时会直接出现在「今天」页。
助手待在装着项目仓库的工作区里时，FULI 自己找到仓库，不用再填文件夹。
保存共享后会说明结果：共享了几个项目，或者为什么没保存。
en: Work sent from another computer shows on Today as soon as it waits for you.
An assistant working in a workspace that holds the repository needs no folder filled in.
Saving shares now says what happened: how many projects are shared, or why it was not saved.
